properties.summary: The Moffett Park Specific Plan's ten zoning districts and its ecological combining district (11 zones, 1,158 of the plan area's ~1,270 acres), taken as published from the City of Sunnyvale's zoning GIS layers and clipped to the plan boundary. The ecological combining district is drawn as its own open-space zone over the office and employment districts it overlays. Streets aren't zoned in the source, so they're left out. The plan's FAR, density and height limits (adopted plan Table 2 and Figure 30) aren't shown.
properties.note: Zoning districts of the adopted 2023 Moffett Park Specific Plan, from Sunnyvale GIS; zones, not buildings.
properties.georeference: GIS as published (Sunnyvale ZoningLegend layers 1 and 2, requested in WGS84); 100.0% of the layer's MP- district area lies inside the plan boundary. Checked by eye against Ordinance 3218-23 Exhibit B, Figure 26 (p. 26).
properties.license: City of Sunnyvale GIS (no license stated)

properties.label: MP-R residential
properties.source: GIS: Sunnyvale GIS ZoningLegend layer 2 “Zoning District”, query Zoning = 'MP-R'
properties.note: Very high-density housing (Ordinance 3218-23, Exhibit A, SMC 19.29.050, p. 11–12). Category: residential. 141.5 acres in the plan area as drawn.

properties.label: MP-MU mixed use
properties.source: GIS: Sunnyvale GIS ZoningLegend layer 2 “Zoning District”, query Zoning = 'MP-MU'
properties.note: Standalone residential, standalone office, or mixed-use development (Ordinance 3218-23, Exhibit A, SMC 19.29.050, p. 11–12). Housing here must be built to at least 36 units/acre (City Council motion of July 11, 2023, item 12, minutes p. 12). Category: mixed-use. 142.0 acres in the plan area as drawn.

properties.label: MP-AC activity center
properties.source: GIS: Sunnyvale GIS ZoningLegend layer 2 “Zoning District”, query Zoning = 'MP-AC'
properties.note: A mix of office, residential and commercial uses, with neighborhood-serving shops, services and entertainment in ground-floor storefronts (Ordinance 3218-23, Exhibit A, SMC 19.29.050, p. 11–12). Category: mixed-use. 74.9 acres in the plan area as drawn.

properties.label: MP-O1 office 1
properties.source: GIS: Sunnyvale GIS ZoningLegend layer 2 “Zoning District”, query Zoning = 'MP-O1'
properties.note: Densification of existing office campuses in the Posolmi and Onizuka neighborhoods; no housing (Ordinance 3218-23, Exhibit A, SMC 19.29.050, p. 11–12). Category: office. In the city's GIS the ecological combining district covers 3.2 of the district's 226.5 acres; that part is drawn as the open-space zone, the rest here. 223.3 acres in the plan area as drawn.

properties.label: MP-O2 office 2
properties.source: GIS: Sunnyvale GIS ZoningLegend layer 2 “Zoning District”, query Zoning = 'MP-O2'
properties.note: Higher-intensity corporate and professional office near the activity center, residential and mixed-use districts and transit; no housing (Ordinance 3218-23, Exhibit A, SMC 19.29.050, p. 11–12). Category: office. 177.1 acres in the plan area as drawn.

properties.label: MP-E1 mixed employment 1
properties.source: GIS: Sunnyvale GIS ZoningLegend layer 2 “Zoning District”, query Zoning = 'MP-E1'
properties.note: Corporate and professional office, light industrial and other non-residential uses in an urban pattern with integrated open space; no housing (Ordinance 3218-23, Exhibit A, SMC 19.29.050, p. 11–12). Category: office, the district's first-named use. 44.1 acres in the plan area as drawn.

properties.label: MP-E2 mixed employment 2
properties.source: GIS: Sunnyvale GIS ZoningLegend layer 2 “Zoning District”, query Zoning = 'MP-E2'
properties.note: A mix of office, R&D and industrial uses; no housing (Ordinance 3218-23, Exhibit A, SMC 19.29.050, p. 11–12). This district is the Lockheed Martin core campus (outlined on Ordinance 3218-23 Figure 26, p. 26; Sunnyvale GIS GeneralPlan layer 8, 'Lockheed Core Campus'). Category: industrial, the closest fit for an office/R&D/industrial employment district. 143.7 acres in the plan area as drawn.

properties.label: MP-E3 mixed employment 3
properties.source: GIS: Sunnyvale GIS ZoningLegend layer 2 “Zoning District”, query Zoning = 'MP-E3'
properties.note: A mix of office, R&D and light industrial; no housing; the ordinance says MP-E3 shall be combined with the ecological combining district (Ordinance 3218-23, Exhibit A, SMC 19.29.050, p. 11–12). Category: industrial, as for MP-E2. In the city's GIS the ecological combining district covers 96.4 of the district's 147.5 acres; that part is drawn as the open-space zone, the rest here. 51.1 acres in the plan area as drawn.

properties.label: MP-H hospitality
properties.source: GIS: Sunnyvale GIS ZoningLegend layer 2 “Zoning District”, query Zoning = 'MP-H'
properties.note: Hotel and hospitality uses; no housing (Ordinance 3218-23, Exhibit A, SMC 19.29.050, p. 11–12). Category: commercial. 18.1 acres in the plan area as drawn.

properties.label: MP-PF public facilities
properties.source: GIS: Sunnyvale GIS ZoningLegend layer 2 “Zoning District”, query Zoning = 'MP-PF'
properties.note: Governmental, public utility and educational buildings and facilities; no housing (Ordinance 3218-23, Exhibit A, SMC 19.29.050, p. 11–12). Category: civic. 42.2 acres in the plan area as drawn.

properties.label: Ecological combining district
properties.source: GIS: Sunnyvale GIS ZoningLegend layer 1 “Combining District”, query CombiningD = 'ECD'
properties.note: Preserves, expands and enhances green space and biological resources in the plan area's northwest corner, with public access and passive recreation; new commercial, industrial, office and residential uses aren't allowed (Ordinance 3218-23, Exhibit A, SMC 19.29.050(k) and 19.29.060(b), p. 12–13). Overlays MP-O1 (3.2 acres), MP-E3 (96.4 acres). Category: open-space. 99.6 acres in the plan area as drawn.
